room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent as part of in-patient treatment but no explicit cap or category restriction is stated in the wording. Shared Accommodation Benefit waives non-medical expense exclusion if insured opts for shared room at network hospital.

icu.note: ICU charges are covered under in-patient treatment but no specific cap or limit is mentioned.

copayment.note: Co-payment of 20% of eligible claim is applicable only if opted and mentioned in the Policy Schedule. No co-pay applies if Tier 2 insured avails treatment in Tier 1.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance cover capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. HbA1C checkup benefit capped at ₹750 per claim (max 2/year). No disease-wise sub-limits on main hospitalisation cover found.

initial_waiting.note: No explicit 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses is stated in the wording. Standard waiting periods listed are PED (24 months) and specific disease (24 months). Diabetes and Hypertension are covered from inception.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months. Notably, Type 2 Diabetes, IFG, IGT, Type 1 Diabetes and Hypertension are explicitly excluded from PED waiting — covered from day 1.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye, etc.) have a 24-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each claim-free renewal year irrespective of claims; maximum 100% of base SI.

restoration.note: Restore benefit reinstates 100% of basic SI once per policy year on complete or partial utilisation of SI + cumulative bonus. Single claim cannot exceed basic SI + cumulative bonus. Applicable for in-patient benefits only.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered as listed; must be under GA/LA in hospital/day care centre for <24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the policy.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered in AYUSH Hospital. OPD/day-care AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Cost of surgery to harvest organ from donor covered. Donor's pre/post-hospitalisation expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation for emergencies.

modern_treatments.note: No explicit mention of modern/robotic surgery cover or sub-limits in the policy wording.

consumables.note: Annexure I lists non-medical/consumable items (gloves, etc.) as excluded. No consumables rider available.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only. Treatment outside India is excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD treatment, treatment outside India, pancreatic islet transplant, stem cell harvesting, dental (unless hospitalised), hearing aids/spectacles

optional_riders.display: Optional 20% co-payment (reduces premium); Wellness Programme (Silver: self-funded checkups; Gold: insurer-funded checkups with premium discounts)
